headline: Clinton order changes which federal officials handle foreign aid programs and controls on weapons exports.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with how the federal government runs foreign assistance programs and controls the export of weapons and military equipment. Based on its title, it appears to assign or update which agencies and officials carry out duties under the laws covering these areas. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run foreign aid and arms export programs
who_it_affects.how: They may have duties assigned or shifted among them for running these programs.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that export weapons or military equipment
who_it_affects.how: The order concerns how the government runs export controls on the products they sell abroad.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 12, 1996; exact effective date not stated in the source provided.
